meta.name: ai-research-reproduction
meta.description: Rigor Reproduce compatible skill slug for README-first deep learning repository reproduction. Use when the user wants an end-to-end, minimal-trustworthy flow that reads the repository first, selects the smallest documented inference or evaluation target, coordinates intake, setup, trusted execution, optional trusted training, optional repository analysis, and optional paper-gap resolution, enforces conservative patch rules, records evidence assumptions deviations and human decision points, and writes the standardized `repro_outputs/` bundle. Do not use for paper summary, generic environment setup, isolated repo scanning, standalone command execution, silent protocol changes, score chasing, or broad research assistance outside repository-grounded reproduction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按论文仓库跑通深度学习模型的推理与训练,并留下可核对的复现证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有一篇深度学习论文和对应代码仓库,想按标准流程复现结果。
copy.tagline_en: Reproduce a deep-learning repo end to end and leave verifiable evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a deep learning paper and its repo and want to reproduce the results.

howto.what: 它会先读仓库 README,挑出最小的推理或评估目标,再按步骤准备环境、执行并记录证据与偏差;尽量不改代码,最后在 repro_outputs/ 里写出总结、命令、日志等文件。
howto.when: 当你的目标是带 README 的 AI 代码仓库,且要求跨准备、执行、训练验证等多个阶段复现一个小目标时触发。不用于论文摘要、通用环境配置或单独跑命令。

say.text: 帮我复现这个仓库的推理结果,先读 README
say.note: 会选最小目标并写出 repro_outputs/ 输出包

say.text: 按 README 跑一遍评估,记录偏差和假设
say.note: 执行证据与假设写入 LOG.md

say.text: 只做训练启动验证,不要全量训练
say.note: 更完整的训练声明前会暂停等你确认

howto.what_en: It reads the repo README first, picks the smallest documented inference or evaluation target, then coordinates environment setup, trusted execution, conservative patching and evidence logging, and writes the repro_outputs/ bundle.
howto.when_en: Use when the target is an AI code repo with a README, scripts or configs, and the request spans trusted phases like intake, setup, execution or training verification for a small reproducible target.

say_en.text: Reproduce this repo's inference and read the README first
say_en.note: Picks the smallest target, writes repro_outputs/

say_en.text: Run the documented evaluation per README and log deviations
say_en.note: Execution evidence and assumptions go to LOG.md

say_en.text: Only verify training startup, no full training
say_en.note: Pauses for your confirmation before fuller claims
